Title: Open orders remain on exchange after shutdown
Description: After the bot is stopped (Ctrl-C or kill) the orders it placed are still resting live on the exchange.

Title: Logging is stdout print statements only
Description: Trade and error events are only printed to the console; there is nothing structured or queryable to search later.

Title: No order-rate anomaly throttle
Description: During the March incident a strategy loop fired a burst of orders before anyone noticed; nothing pauses the bot when the order rate spikes.

Title: Dashboard hardcodes instrument list
Description: The dashboard only ever shows two instruments; the others never appear even when they trade.

Title: Keep every call on X-API-Key
Description: Guardrail: send X-API-Key on every authenticated REST call — the SSE feed at /events is public, no key needed. As you add new calls, don't introduce Authorization or X-Team-Token; the exchange rejects anything else on the calls that do need a key.

Title: Stale P&L shown during reconnect
Description: During a connectivity blip the P&L figures freeze at their last values instead of clearing until fresh data arrives.

Title: Dashboard refreshes slowly and misses market events
Description: The dashboard only updates roughly every 30 seconds; it lags badly in fast markets and never shows announcements or market-halt events.

Title: No portfolio-level exposure cap
Description: Correlated instruments can all run at full size at the same time; total directional exposure is unbounded.

Title: No per-position stop-loss
Description: A losing position can run indefinitely; there is no stop-loss.

Title: Connectivity indicator can be misleading
Description: The green/red status dot shows ONLINE even when the bot itself has died, as long as the exchange is reachable.

Title: Bot stops reacting to prices after a disconnect
Description: After a network blip the bot silently stops reacting to prices with no error shown; restarting it fixes it.

Title: Mean-reversion loses on the secondary instrument in a trend
Description: The secondary instrument's mean-reversion produces false buy signals during a clear downtrend — it reads a falling series as a run of dips and buys into it.

Title: Market-making module disabled
Description: There is a market-making strategy file but it is commented out / disabled and not running.

Title: Fixed trade size
Description: The bot always trades the same fixed quantity regardless of volatility or liquidity.

Title: Format numbers with a period decimal separator
Description: Guardrail: when you add number/currency formatting or data exports, force a period decimal separator (e.g. en-US). A comma-decimal locale would corrupt exported values.

Title: Errors are swallowed silently
Description: Failures during order submission and in the main loop are swallowed and only printed; they aren't classified or retried.

Title: No price chart
Description: There is no price chart on the dashboard — only a commented-out placeholder.

Title: Crash when an instrument is absent from the portfolio response
Description: The bot and the dashboard crash (KeyError / undefined) for an instrument that hasn't traded yet and is missing from the portfolio response.

Title: Order left in an unknown state on gateway timeout
Description: When an order submission times out (504 GATEWAY_TIMEOUT) the order is left in an unknown state and is never reconciled.

Title: Timestamps displayed in UTC
Description: Dashboard timestamps are in UTC; this has caused reconciliation errors against the ops team, who work in local time.
